dunbarton--sobremesa.description: Steve Saka's first Dunbarton blend, released in 2015 and made at Joya de Nicaragua: a La Meca Ecuadorian Habano Rosado wrapper and Mexican Matacapan binder around four Nicaraguan fillers and Pennsylvania Broadleaf ligero. A rich, balanced after-dinner cigar of cocoa, earth and cedar with a creamy middle.

thirds.notes: Cocoa and earth lead over cedar and espresso, with black pepper on the retrohale and a hint of citrus.
The texture turns creamy around chocolate and earth, with nuts and a gentle, lingering spice.
Cedar and earth come forward, the cream fades, and dark chocolate and nuts stay to the end.

sources.title: Cigar Coop – Sobremesa Cervantes Fino review

dunbarton--sobremesa-solita.description: Sobremesa Solita carries the original Sobremesa blend: a La Meca Ecuadorian Habano #1 Rosado wrapper, Mexican Matacapan binder and Nicaraguan fillers with Pennsylvania Broadleaf ligero, in four sizes. It smokes deep and earthy, with cocoa, cedar and coffee and a long, spiced finish.

sources.title: Luxury Cigar Club – Dunbarton Sobremesa Solita

dunbarton--sobremesa-tapa-negra.description: A 2026 two-tone Sobremesa from Joya de Nicaragua: an Ecuadorian Connecticut wrapper with the head capped in dark Nicaraguan sun-grown leaf, over a Mexican Matacapan binder and Nicaraguan filler. The dark cap gives a spicier start of pepper and cedar before the smoke settles into cream and soft sweetness.
